title: A waiting-page option picture fills its card width
why: Owner, 2026-11-09 20:47 CST: "the images are so small in the artifact cockpit." Owner ask ask-mwa3hdpa1j (20:52 CST, from the Degen coordinator). Checked by triage 20:53 CST against skills/waiting-page/page.html on main ddaa393c0: optPic (line 1442) passes maxScale 1 and maxH 480 to fitFrame, and fitFrame (line 2861) takes sc = min(maxScale, card width / design width, 480 / design height). So a 390x844 phone mockup draws at about 0.57, near 220 px wide, and a two-page Duo mockup shrinks further.
note: Owner's brief: fix it so a mockup fills its card width (raise the cap, or let the picture scale above 1x), and show it at phone and desktop widths, light and dark. A screen change: designer before the builder unless text-only (it is not), design reviewer after.
